assets.prompt: Create a premium dark fantasy artifact material asset for the FATE numerology room, square composition, perfectly frontal orthographic view of an intricate circular antique brass celestial dial, isolated centered on pure transparent background. Concentric engraved brass rings with minute ticks and tiny abstract geometric incisions, a very fine warm golden outer rim, dark patinated inner metal, exquisite tactile goldsmith craftsmanship and delicate astronomical radial geometry. Open empty circular center taking up 50 percent of diameter, also transparent, so live teal glass and programmatic numbers can be rendered underneath. Entire circular object within frame with 8 percent transparent padding. No readable numbers, letters, words, zodiac signs, logos, UI, cards, decorations outside the ring. Rich cinematic soft sidelight from upper left, restrained aged gold and verdigris accents, realistic depth, subtle imperfections, museum quality occult scientific instrument. This is a game runtime layer, no baked interface or scene background.
